title: From lecture notes into review
description: A chosen fragment becomes a study card. The question keeps its link to the explanation, so the answer can be clarified.

blocks.text: A student keeps lecture notes and prepares questions for review separately. Linking the two can cut down on entering the same thing twice and keep the explanation beside the short answer.

quote.text: Let me start off by saying that I absolutely adore the plethora of features offered by this app, it has made my life as a stressed-out premed student a little more bearable. Having ways to organize my notes while creating flashcards to test my retention of material has been incredible.

blocks.text: A chosen fragment turns into a card once the learner has edited the question and the answer themselves. From the card you can open the original place in the notes.

When the notes are corrected, the linked cards have to be marked for revisiting. An automatic deck made out of every paragraph creates extra work picking through it; the convenience is worth testing on the material of one real topic.
